translate_en|mods/CarryingCapacityTweak/: Turns Carrying Capacity Tweak on or off.

Adjusts the scaling factor that, together with your character's strength, determines your character's inventory capacity. Higher value => Greater capacity.
 Accepts values from 1 to 14, with a default of 7. 
 
 Setting Examples: 
 A value of 3 results in a max carrying capacity of 20kg. (normal Project Zomboid experience) 
 A value of 7 results in a max carrying capacity of 30kg. (default mod setting) 
 A value of 11 results in a max carrying capacity of 40kg. 
 A value of 14 results in a max carrying capacity of 50kg.
